title: Millennium Ceramics master catalog manifest
purpose: Canonical inventory entry point. Product records remain in source-specific datasets so original supplier provenance is never overwritten.

datasets.publication_rule: Only records with individual verified display assets are customer-facing.
Every record must preserve a source catalogue/page reference and a verified supplier display image.

datasets.scope: Unpublished source-text candidates from new bathroom catalogues
datasets.publication_rule: Not customer-facing until visually verified against source page and image.

source_separation: Supplier groups must not be merged, renamed or inferred from display artwork. Chinese sources remain separate from TAU, SEBACH, Mitrani and all other supplier groups.
